response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 20 days ago. The electronics-specific rule (priority 20) dominates the standard 30-day window rule (priority 10). Since days_since_delivery (20) > 15, RET-003 applies and the return is not accepted. Final_sale is false so RET-012 doesn't apply, defective is null so RET-020 doesn't apply, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
